selection.ownership: BigMailer / Founder Bits, United States (New York). The reviewed edition is the global REST API at api.bigmailer.io, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official BigMailer REST authentication (X-API-Key header), brands/lists/contacts read endpoints, company identity (US email-marketing vendor), and dated incident search for BigMailer security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying platform incident found in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official BigMailer REST API at https://api.bigmailer.io, X-API-Key header authentication, GET /v1/brands, GET /v1/brands/{brand_id}, GET /v1/brands/{brand_id}/lists, and GET /v1/brands/{brand_id}/contacts were confirmed on 2026-09-13. Company identity is a US email-marketing vendor. Targeted incident search found no qualifying unresolved platform compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
